1.ja: וצנע בצלאל אלצנדוק מן כ'שב אלסנט
1.en: And Bezalel made the ark from acacia wood
two cubits and a half its length
and a cubit and a half its width
and a cubit and a half its height

2.ja: וג'שאה בד'הב כ'אלץ. מן דאכ'ל ומן כ'ארג
2.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, from within and from without

2.ja: וצנע לה. זיגא מן ד'הב מסתדירא
2.en: and he made for it a border of gold, encircling all around

3.ja: וצאג' לה ארבע חלק מן ד'הב. וגעלהא פי ארבע גהאתה
3.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and set them on its four sides
3.he: וַיִּצֹק לוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב עַל אַרְבַּע פַּעֲמֹתָיו

3.en: two rings on one side of it
and two rings on the other side

4.en: And he made carrying-poles from acacia wood

5.ja: ואדכ'ל אלדהוק פי אלחלק. עלי' גאנבי אלצנדוק
5.en: And he inserted the poles into the rings, on the two sides of the ark
5.he: וַיָּבֵא אֶת-הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן

5.en: so that it might be carried by them

6.en: And he made a cover of pure gold
two cubits and a half its length
and a cubit and a half its width

7.ja: וצנע כרובין מן ד'הב. מצמתין צנעהמא
7.en: And he made two cherubim of gold — solid he made them
7.he: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי כְרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֹתָם

7.en: from the two ends of the cover

8.en: One of them from its right side
and the other from its left side

8.ja: מן נפס אלג'שא. צנעהמא מן טרפיה
8.en: from the body of the cover itself he made them, from its two ends

9.ja: פכאנא אלכרובין באסטין אגנחתהמא אלי' פוק
9.en: And the two cherubim were spreading their wings upward
sheltering with them over the cover
and the face of one was toward the other
and toward the cover were their faces turned

10.en: And he made the table from acacia wood
two cubits its length, and a cubit its width
and a cubit and a half its height

11.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold

11.ja: וצנע להא. זיגא מן ד'הב מסתדירא
11.en: and made for it a border of gold, encircling all around

12.ja: וצנע להא חאפה. מקדאר קבצ'ה מסתדירא
12.en: And he made for it a rim of the breadth of a fist, encircling all around

12.ja: וצנע להא זיגא מן ד'הב. לחאפתהא מסתדירא
12.en: and he made for it a border of gold for its rim, encircling all around

13.ja: וצאג' להא ארבע חלק מן דהב
13.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold

13.ja: וגעל אלחלק פי ארבע גהאתהא. אלתי לארבע ארגלהא
13.en: and set the rings on its four sides — which were at its four legs
13.he: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת-הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָיו

14.en: Alongside the rim were the rings
a place for the poles — so that the table might be carried by them

15.en: And he made the poles from acacia wood
so that the table might be carried by them

16.en: And he made the vessels that were upon it
the spoons, and the flagons with which it is covered
16.he: וְאֵת מְנַקִּיֹּתָיו וְאֶת-הַקְּשָׂו‍ֹת אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן

17.ja: וצנע אלמנארה מן ד'הב כ'אלץ. מצמתה צנעהא
17.en: And he made the lampstand of pure gold — solid he made it
17.he: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת-הַמְּנֹרָה זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֶת-הַמְּנֹרָה

17.en: its cups, its pomegranates, and its blossoms were all of it

18.en: And six branches extending from its sides
three branches from one side of it
and three branches from the other side

19.ja: ת'לאת' גאמאת מלווזאת. פי כל קצבה תפאחה וסוסנה
19.en: Three cups fashioned in almond-shapes on each branch, a pomegranate and a blossom
19.he: שְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפֶרַח

19.ja: כד'אך צנע לאלסת אלקצבאת. אלכ'ארגאת מנהא
19.en: thus he made it for the six branches extending from it

20.ja: ופי נפס אלמנארה ארבע גאמאת. מלווזאת
20.en: And in the body of the lampstand itself, four cups fashioned in almond-shapes
with their pomegranates and their blossoms

21.en: And a pomegranate beneath each two branches of it
thus for the six branches extending from it

22.en: Its pomegranates and its shaft were of it

22.ja: כלהא מצמתה ואחדה מן ד'הב כ'אלץ
22.en: all of it was one solid piece of pure gold

23.en: And he made for it seven lamps
and its tongs and its fire-pans of pure gold

24.en: From a talent of pure gold he made it

25.ja: וצנע מד'בח אלב'כור מן כ'שב אלסנט
25.en: And he made the altar of incense from acacia wood
one cubit its length and one cubit its width — square
and two cubits its height; its horns were of it

26.ja: וג'שאה בד'הב כ'אלץ. סטחה וחיטאנה. מסתדירא
26.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold — its top and its walls all around
26.he: וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר אֶת-גַּגּוֹ וְאֶת-קִירֹתָיו סָבִיב

26.ja: וצנע לה. זיגא מן ד'הב מסתדירא
26.en: and he made for it a border of gold, encircling all around

27.ja: וחלקתין מן ד'הב צנעהמא לה תחת זיגה. פי גהתיה
27.en: And two rings of gold he made for it beneath its border, on its two sides
27.he: וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב עָשָׂה-לוֹ מִתַּחַת לְזֵרוֹ עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹתָיו

27.ja: כד'אך עלי גאנביה מכאנא לאלד'הוק. ליחמל בהא
27.en: as a place for the poles, so that it might be carried by them

28.en: And he made the poles from acacia wood

29.en: And he made the consecrated anointing oil
and the pure incense of resins — the work of a perfumer
